title: Gant's repertoire and accompanying Amanda Randolph
summary: Gant played all the popular songs, accompanied Amanda Randolph, and could stride.

blocks.x: endless as far as I'm concerned.
Yeah. Think back. What kind of repertoire was it? All the popular songs?
All the popular songs, more or less. Mostly popular songs.
Wouldn't he have gone back to -- what was it -- to Victor Herbert and "Indian Summer" and "Down by the Old Mill Stream"...
Yeah. He did all those. You see, he did everything.
And, of course, I suppose he played for the singers?
